text: Reefer 41 went offline at the Quellby depot after under-voltage warnings; the depot confirmed the battery was disconnected for the compressor repair.
The webhook signing secret was rotated in the platform console during the quarterly key rotation.
The overspeed-obd rule on Linehaul Tractor 27 switched to sync status error.
The fleet lead flagged two overspeed events on City Hauler 12 for review, EV-9101 and EV-9102.
The workshop reported that Shop Pickup 2 logs harsh brakes on gentle stops and suspected its 1 Hz sampling.
Route Van 8's driving rules were resynced after a template update.
An operator's request to reboot City Hauler 12 was refused by the role check; an admin rebooted it ten minutes later.
Route Van 8's SMS inbox was cleared after the fleet lead approved it; 4 messages were deleted.
An OBD scan on Linehaul Tractor 27 before departure came back with no fault codes.
A purge of an old trial device was approved and finished in 11 minutes.
